items.name: THE STRONGEST OF HISTORY
items.requirement: Hold the #1 spot on the Highest Kills leaderboard.
items.whoCanUse: Normal players can chase it, but only the current #1 holder keeps it.
items.displayBehavior: Equips from the Titles inventory tab and appears as a chat prefix plus an overhead bracket title.
items.sourceNote: Source says the title requires reaching and maintaining Highest Kills rank #1.
items.imageStatus: hidden by policy; no per-title image
items.verificationNote: Fandom Titles page last edited 2026-05-23 lists this as the #1 Highest Kills title.

items.name: CONTENT CREATOR
items.requirement: Reach 15k YouTube subscribers or 25k TikTok followers, post at least 5 Jujutsu Shenanigans videos, then contact a game moderator on Discord.
items.whoCanUse: Eligible content creators after moderator approval.
items.displayBehavior: Equips from the Titles inventory tab, appears as a chat prefix plus an overhead bracket title, and source notes it grants public-server Free Cam.
items.sourceNote: Source lists the audience/video requirement, Discord moderator contact step, and Free Cam permission.
items.imageStatus: hidden by policy; no per-title image
items.verificationNote: No official Discord announcement was available in this pass; source page is current community source.
